Today, during an otherwise typical run-through my routine tasks – the mundane and essential – an ordinary item unexpectedly revealed one small, invaluable piece about my habits, or more accurately a confirmation about a positive inclination that I've noticed in myself and wanted confirmation.

In sorting the mail into its various envelopes for addressing (the post has a peculiar system and requires each item have a separate piece) I happened onto what seemed to have become my regular card from an old university class. It’s an ongoing series – monthly updates on their events. 

As the paper slipped onto my lap for the tenth or so week in the year and unfolded, I saw that it was from our class's social committee, an enthusiastic pair who have continued the traditions I held fond, even when not physically back at that place. A casual glance at this latest edition, as it's often been
